Compiler image smoke tests are paused in CI, so the sample builds and Mach-O checks are currently unverified by Woodpecker. The smoke stage remains available for explicit local image validation. The SwiftUI macro parity check against Xcode's own plugins (macros:check) needs macOS with each Xcode installed.

The Foundation-only Swift suite runs in the affected-only hkctl native macOS lane; signed Catalyst build and HomeKit launch smoke verification remain local because they require a development team and HomeKit entitlement.

The Swift build/test/coverage suite requires macOS and has no Linux CI lane today - the homelab macOS agent (packages/homelab/mac-ci/) is dormant, so verify:macos is a local-only developer/release gate, not a CI gate. Linux CI runs only the portable lint:swift (SwiftLint) task.
The Playwright suite runs in the dedicated main and pull-request browser lanes.
